preconditions.expression: root is None or (hasattr(root, 'data') and hasattr(root, 'left') and hasattr(root, 'right') and hasattr(root, 'height'))
preconditions.description: The root is either None or a valid AVL node with data, left, right, and height attributes.
The value to be inserted is an integer.

preconditions.expression: root is None or (root.left is None or (root.left.data < root.data and root.left.height >= 0)) and (root.right is None or (root.right.data > root.data and root.right.height >= 0))
preconditions.description: If root is not None, it satisfies BST property (left < root < right) and non-negative height.

postconditions.expression: return_value is None or (hasattr(return_value, 'data') and hasattr(return_value, 'left') and hasattr(return_value, 'right') and hasattr(return_value, 'height'))
postconditions.description: The returned root is either None or a valid AVL node with required attributes.
The inorder traversal of the returned tree contains all original nodes plus the inserted value, in sorted order.
The returned tree is a balanced AVL tree (height difference of children is at most 1 for every node).
The returned tree satisfies the binary search tree property.
